title: Region
description: The scale above a field map: a country rather than a walk. A region says what kind of place this is and what lives there; the field maps under it say where the player can actually stand. Regions were entirely unvalidated until the overworld needed them -- seven files, no schema, nothing checking that `continent` or `canon` said anything sensible.

continent.description: Which landmass. Everything authored so far is on jambhudweepa; the field is here rather than assumed so a second continent does not need a migration.

bestiary_region.description: The key species files use for `region`. Deliberately not the entity id: the bestiary was written first and its own vocabulary is what the fauna and flora carry.

biomes.description: Which biomes occur here. Advisory rather than binding -- a field map's `seed_biomes` is what the generator actually draws from.

canon.description: How firmly this is established. `primary` is stated by the source material, `inferred` is a reading canon has committed to.
